_comment: 2026-09-19: LIVE STRATEGY IS NOW TIME-SERIES MOMENTUM (momentum_trader.py), not mean reversion. The mean-reversion settings below are kept because backtest.py/tune.py still use them, but trader.py is no longer what runs live. Reason: a ~2,000-combination sweep found NO profitable mean-reversion configuration at Kraken's 0.80%-per-side taker fee - a round trip costs ~1.65% and the average 15-minute reversion on these coins is smaller than that. Momentum beat buy & hold in 26 of 27 tested parameter combinations with positive expectancy in all 27. See docs/momentum_research_2026-09-19.md. NOTE: momentum trades ~7-30 times a YEAR, not daily - low turnover is precisely why it clears the fee.
